title: Binary search variants
description:
Write the three binary searches every programmer needs.

```
data: 1 3 3 3 5 8 13
first 3 at 1, last 3 at 3, count 3
insert 4 at 4
insert 0 at 0, insert 99 at 7
```
hints: Keep a half-open range `[lo, hi)`: `while (lo < hi) { mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2; if (v[mid] < x) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid; }` (lesson 2.01).
The last 3 is at `firstGreater(v, 3) - 1`, and the count is the difference of the two.
requirements: `firstAtLeast(v, x)` (like `lower_bound`), `firstGreater(v, x)` (like `upper_bound`) as index functions with your own loops.
Use them for "first", "last" and "count" of a value.
stretch: Binary search on the answer: find the smallest integer square root of a big number.
